author: Saikron
body:
Hi, so i made a appeal almost 4 months ago (https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/b096dceb5), and Tazz told me to appeal again in 3-5 months to appeal my ban. 

¨You have waited two months. Therefore, appeal in 3-5 months and your ban will most likely be appealed.¨

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hey,

Since you've waited about 6 months, I've decided to appeal you based on the fact that you probably have learned your lesson now. We expect that you don't do similar things and be sure to read through the rules for any clarifications needed. Welcome back!

Regards,
Fouled
